name: Tsunami Restaurant & Sushi Bar (South Jordan / Lehi) Salmon Nigiri, Sunshine Roll & Chicken Udon Soup
brandOrRestaurant: Tsunami Restaurant & Sushi Bar (South Jordan / Lehi / Sugar House, UT)
whyItWorks: With locations in South Jordan (106th S / District area near Herriman) and Lehi (Traverse Mountain near BambooHR), Tsunami offers ultra-fresh Salmon Nigiri, steamed white rice with teriyaki salmon/chicken, and soothing dashi-broth Chicken Udon noodle soup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Salmon Nigiri, a plain California or Salmon Avocado Roll, or Chicken/Tempura-Free Udon Soup—avoid rolls topped with thin lemon slices (like the Sunshine Roll unless you request "no lemon slices") or spicy jalapeno/sriracha sauces.
watchOuts: IMPORTANT: Tsunami's popular "Sunshine Roll" is topped with thin raw lemon slices (citrus trigger)—always order it with "NO lemon" or stick to Salmon Nigiri & Avocado Rolls
